title: C4OS Grill Question 042A - Browser Annotation Attachment Model

questions.label: Should C4OS follow the Codex-style Browser annotation model shown in the sample?
questions.help: Recommended: yes. The sample shows an annotation toolbar, selected target outline, numbered marker, optional comment input, and attachment evidence.
options: Yes; use Codex-style target outline, marker, comment, and evidence attachment
Use only screenshot plus comment, without element target metadata
Use only element target metadata, without screenshot evidence
Build a different C4OS-specific annotation model
Other

questions.label: What should a Browser annotation attachment include?
questions.help: Recommended: include marker screenshot, selected target metadata, marker number, user comment, page URL, frame, selector/path, and viewport context.
options: Screenshot, target metadata, marker number, comment, URL, frame, selector/path, and viewport
Screenshot, marker number, and comment only
Target metadata, marker number, and comment only
Screenshot only
Other

questions.label: What screenshot scope should annotations attach by default?
questions.help: Recommended: attach viewport evidence around the selected target. This matches the sample and keeps the attachment focused.
options: Viewport evidence around the selected target
Full page screenshot
Cropped selected element only
Ask every annotation
Other

questions.label: What happens to active annotations after send?
questions.help: Recommended: persist the attachment evidence on the sent prompt, then clear active unsent annotations from the Browser surface.
options: Persist on sent prompt attachments; clear active Browser annotations
Persist visually in Browser after send
Delete annotation records after send
Ask the user on send
Other

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether multiple annotations can attach to one prompt, whether comments are optional, edit/delete behavior, or how annotation attachments appear in the prompt composer.
